whatsNewInPET.title: Exam Dates Confirmed
whatsNewInPET.detail: Exam scheduled for 25, 30 October and 1 November 2026 across approved examination centres in Uttar Pradesh.

whatsNewInPET.title: Strict 0.25 Negative Marking
whatsNewInPET.detail: Each wrong answer penalises 0.25 marks. Accuracy is crucial for securing a 99+ percentile.

whatsNewInPET.title: Heavy Weightage on DI (20 Marks)
whatsNewInPET.detail: Graph Interpretation (10 marks) and Table Interpretation (10 marks) account for 20% of the entire paper.

whatsNewInPET.title: Current Affairs & UP Special
whatsNewInPET.detail: 10 marks for National/International Current Affairs and 10 marks for General Awareness with special UP GK questions.

whatsNewInPET.title: Validity of Scorecard
whatsNewInPET.detail: PET scorecard remains valid for 1 full year from the date of final result declaration for all Group C notifications.

patternHistory.notes: First ever PET conducted on 24 August 2021 in 2 shifts. Set the standard 15-subject format.
Conducted on 15 and 16 October 2022 across 4 shifts. Graph/Table interpretation saw increased analytical depth.
Conducted on 28 and 29 October 2023. Questions in History and Economy adhered closely to NCERT standard.
Maintained identical 100-question format; strengthened data security and normalized scoring.
Held on 6-7 September 2025 across 35 UP districts with high participation.
Current official cycle: 25, 30 October & 1 November 2026. Required for all 2026-2027 UPSSSC Group C Mains.
